title: Explore Separately, Adopt Selectively: Execution-Guided Tool Use over Large Tool Libraries
abstract: arXiv:2610.22688v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents must discover relevant tools from large libraries, e.g., thousands of tools, as new needs arise during task execution. When several candidates could satisfy the same need, execution may be required to identify the relevant one. Investigating candidates in a shared trajectory can leave alternatives unexplored or allow failed attempts to influence subsequent reasoning. To address this, we present BRIA (BRanch-Inspect-Adopt), a simple yet effective agent that temporarily isolates candidate investigations in separate branches. Each branch retrieves and executes tools to investigate its candidate; a task agent inspects the resulting execution evidence and adopts only useful results into its continuing trajectory. BRIA retrieves additional tools as new capability needs arise during task execution. translated_title: 分别探索，择优采纳：面向大型工具库的执行引导式工具使用
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型智能体在任务执行过程中出现新需求时，必须从包含数千个工具的大型工具库中发现相关工具。当多个候选工具都可能满足同一需求时，可能需要通过实际执行来识别真正适用的工具。在共享轨迹中调查候选工具可能导致部分备选方案未被探索，或使失败的尝试影响后续推理。为解决这一问题，我们提出了BRIA（BRanch-Inspect-Adopt，分支-检查-采纳），一个简单而有效的智能体，它将候选工具的调查暂时隔离在独立的分支中。每个分支检索并执行工具以调查其对应的候选工具；任务智能体检查由此产生的执行证据，并只将有用的结果采纳到其继续执行的主轨迹中。BRIA还能在任务执行过程中出现新的能力需求时动态检索更多工具。我们在PlanBench-XL和MCP-Atlas基准上，使用包含1897个工具的共享工具池、三个语言模型以及静态分析设置对BRIA进行了评估。
tldr: 提出BRIA智能体，通过将候选工具调查隔离到独立分支、检查执行证据并仅将有用的结果采纳回主轨迹，解决了大规模工具库中多候选工具选择时失败尝试污染推理轨迹的问题。
en_tdlr: BRIA is an execution-guided agent that isolates candidate tool investigations into separate branches, inspects the resulting execution evidence, and selectively adopts only useful results into its main trajectory, enabling reliable tool discovery and selection in large tool libraries.
